        if outside9:

            # the lower piece, which also has a vertical pair of 9s, turns CW.
            pair = [p for p in outside9 if p[1] < ac0]
            single = [p for p in outside9 if p[1] > ac1]
            clockwise = bool(pair)
            target = pair[0] if pair else single[0]
        else:
            continue

        obj = [[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        h,w = len(obj),len(obj[0])
        # Clear the source and all destination maroons.
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                g[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in outside9:
            g[r][c] = bg
        # A remote lone maroon used only as a directional cue is removed too.
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                if g[r][c] == 9 and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1):
                    if abs(r-ar0) < 5 or abs(r-ar1) < 5:
                        g[r][c] = bg

        source = body9[0]
        sr,sc = source[0]-r0,source[1]-c0
        if clockwise:
            out = [list(row) for row in zip(*obj[::-1])]
            pr,pc = sc,h-1-sr
        else:
            out = [list(row) for row in zip(*obj)][::-1]
            pr,pc = w-1-sc,sr
        nr,nc = target[0]-pr,target[1]-pc
        for r in range(len(out)):
            for c in range(len(out[0])):
                v = out[r][c]
                if v == bg or v == 0:
                    continue
                if v == 9:
                    v = 8
                elif v == 1:
                    v = 2
                elif v == 2:
                    v = 1
                rr,cc = nr+r,nc+c
                if 0 <= rr < H and 0 <= cc < W:
                    g[rr][cc] = v
        g[target[0]][target[1]] = 9
    return g
